about: Wording-only edits to titles and explanations (tiles and membership unchanged), applied at activation after revisions.json. Original text is kept here.

original.title: Beta-1 selective blockers
original.explanation: These agents preferentially antagonize beta-1 receptors. The source links renal beta-1 blockade to reduced renin release.

CARD-004.title: Beta-1 selective blockers
CARD-004.explanation: These agents preferentially antagonize beta-1 receptors. Blocking renal beta-1 receptors also reduces renin release.
